import re,glob
tot=0;pos=0;tr=0;nocase=0;bad=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.txt')):
    t=open(f).read()
    for p in re.split(r'=== page \d+\n',t)[1:]:
        if 'Case Number' not in p: 
            bad.append((f,p[:80]));continue
        nocase+=1
        m=re.search(r'recommends the following civil\s+penalty:?(.*?)Abstentions',p,re.S|re.I)

        r=m.group(1)
        d=re.search(r'\$+\s*(\d[\d,\s]*\d|\d)',r)
        amt=0
        if d:
            amt=int(re.sub(r'[,\s]','',d.group(1))) if True else 0
        if amt>0:
            pos+=1
            if re.search('training',r,re.I): tr+=1
print(nocase,pos,tr,round(100*tr/pos,1));print(bad)
E
